explanation.text: Meta Platforms said in its 10-Q filed 2025-07-31 that "We anticipate making capital expenditures of approximately $66 billion to $72 billion in 2025 to support our core business and AI efforts."[1] The FY2025 10-K filed 2026-01-29 reports “$69.69 billion of purchases of property and equipment”[2], which is within the range[3]. Computed from reported figures on the company's own definition, which reduces net cash provided by operating activities by purchases of property and equipment and principal payments on finance leases[4], capital expenditures for 2025 come to $72.22 billion, which is above the range[5].
